assay: bulk liver RNA-seq (DNBSEQ-T7), HISAT2 mm10 + featureCounts Gencode vM25 (S4.5.p1)
sample_inclusion: Paper animals: NC n=13, HFD/HAE/HRE n=8 each (S4.1.1.p1, S2.1.p1); RNA-seq n per group not stated in the text. GEO deposits 3 livers per group (12 samples).
primary_estimand: Effect of aerobic (HAE) and resistance (HRE) exercise on liver gene expression in HFD-fed NAFLD mice, each versus sedentary HFD mice
planned_contrasts: HAE vs HFD (S2.6.p1, Fig. 6C; paper: 1,450 DEGs) - primary exercise contrast
HRE vs HFD (S2.6.p1, Fig. 6D; paper: 171 DEGs) - primary exercise contrast
HFD vs NC (S2.6.p1, Fig. 6B; paper: 2,746 DEGs) - diet model check, not an exercise effect
HAE vs HRE (S2.6.p1, Fig. 6E; paper: 625 DEGs) - exercise-modality comparison
repeated_measure_unit: none; one liver per mouse, independent animals
paper_method: DESeq2 1.40.1 pairwise group comparisons (S4.5.p1); exact design formula and whether each pair was fitted separately not stated

paper_threshold.note: text reads 'log2FC < 1 and a p-value < 1E-2'; interpreted as |log2FC| > 1 and raw p < 0.01 (the literal 'log2FC < 1' cannot define DEGs that include up-regulated genes, and the paper reports up- and down-regulated DEGs)

paper_results.named_genes: exercise-upregulated Hsd3b5, Cyp4a12b, Slco1a1; downregulated Cd8b1, Cidea, Ccl7, Sprr1a; Sit1 down in HAE, Slc7a11 down in HRE (S2.7.p1, S4.p1)
paper_results.pathways: KEGG up in HAE vs HFD: retinol metabolism, arachidonic acid metabolism, bile secretion, fatty acid degradation; up in HRE vs HFD: PPAR signaling, unsaturated FA biosynthesis, FA metabolism (S2.6.p2)
